author: opencode-worker-5
text: SCOPE from b7z9.37.3.2 review (edge pass): RootSeqCache is in-memory only — reboot zeroes high-water marks, so an attacker holding a correctly-signed OLD root DIO can replay it post-reboot until a fresh DIO re-arms the cache. When wiring receiver validation, explicitly decide: accept the window (document), persist high-water marks via NonVolatile (like dao_admissions does), or gate on a persisted floor. Do not silently drop this decision. Also: root_seqs_mut() carries an interim #[cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code))] — remove the attribute when your call site lands (it will start erroring as unfulfilled).
